culture-cycles.note: State holidays only; the nine nationwide holidays (in 2027: 1 Jan, 26 and 29 Mar, 1 May, 6 and 17 May, 3 Oct, 25 and 26 Dec) are on Germany's record. Several 2027 dates fall on a weekend, and there is no substitute weekday.

laws.rule: Weimar charges a culture levy on private overnight stays by adults (Kulturförderabgabe), for up to 7 nights: at places with up to 49 rooms EUR 1.10 per night (about A$1.75, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) in a double room or holiday flat and EUR 1.50 in a single; at places with 50 rooms or more EUR 2.25 and EUR 3. Under-18s and work trips are exempt; paying gives free entry to the city museum and the Kunsthalle.
